styleHint: STYLE: match the reference image's rendering exactly — a chunky soft-3D chess piece in the slop.computer desktop-icon style, saturated neon body with painterly pixel-dither shading, rich highlight/shadow modeling, subtle CRT texture, and a glowing rim-light tracing one edge of the silhouette. DETAIL: ornate but readable — visible material shading, glowing accent details (gems, seams, engraved lines), at least three colors per piece. SILHOUETTE: bold and instantly recognizable at 32 pixels, slight 3/4 view like the reference. FRAMING: exactly ONE piece, centered, filling ~85% of the frame height, standing free with NO square base plate under it (unlike the reference), fully transparent background, no text, no chess board, no border.
